verdict.rationale: A note-taking app with an AI plugin ecosystem could plausibly act as an MCP client, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP or connecting to external tool servers. The only AI-related material is a community note about LLM text-generation plugins (obsidian-comm-7), and general plugin extensibility (obsidian-docs-7) is not evidence of MCP client support.
